checks.title: Subnet has a current consumer or reservation declaration
checks.description: A complete current subnet ARM GET is checked for native IP configurations, private endpoints, application gateway configurations, delegations, service links and IP allocations. An absence is a structural review signal, not traffic inactivity or safe deletion.
checks.predicate: PASS when a current consumer or reservation declaration exists; FAIL when all reviewed native fields are empty or absent in a complete bound subnet GET; UNKNOWN for incomplete, foreign, malformed or denied evidence.
checks.remediation_hint: Confirm planned consumers, reservations and ownership before changing the subnet.

checks.title: Load balancer backend pools have a backend or consumer declaration
checks.description: A complete current load balancer ARM GET is checked for each backend pool’s NIC or IP backend declarations and load balancing, outbound or inbound NAT rule consumers. An empty unreferenced pool is a structural review signal, not traffic inactivity or safe deletion.
checks.predicate: FAIL when at least one pool has neither backend declarations nor rule, outbound or NAT consumers in a complete bound parent GET; PASS when each pool has at least one; NOT_APPLICABLE when no pool exists; UNKNOWN for incomplete, foreign, malformed or denied evidence.
checks.remediation_hint: Review planned backend and rule configuration with the load balancer owner before changing an empty pool.
